proposal."},"transferOwnership(address)":{"notice":"Transfer ownership"}},"notice":"Decentralized outcome resolution for EMET claims. ## The Problem In ChallengeV3, `resolveChallenge()` is callable by anyone \u2014 but the jury itself is selected by the contract (pseudo-random). The *verdict* still requires trusted jurors to vote correctly. More critically: the *initial claim outcome* (was the AI's claim true or false?) is decided by whoever calls `resolveClaim()` on the Registry \u2014 a trusted owner call. This is the gap identified in the EMET v2 architecture dialogue: \"EMET knows if an agent staked correctly (on-chain). But 'correct' is  defined by whoever calls resolveChallenge() \u2014 still trusted.\" ## The Solution: Optimistic Resolution Anyone can submit an outcome assertion for any resolved claim:   1. **Propose**: Submit `(claimId, outcome, evidence)` with a bond.      A 48-hour challenge window begins.   2. **Optimistic finalization**: If no one disputes within the window,      the outcome is finalized. No jury needed. The proposer gets their      bond back + a small reward from the protocol fee pool.   3. **Dispute**: Anyone can stake > proposer's bond to challenge the      outcome. Dispute triggers a mini-jury (3 jurors, Minor tier equivalent).      Jury votes within 24h. Majority wins.   4. **Slash + reward**: Wrong proposer forfeits bond to winner + protocol.      Wrong disputer forfeits bond to proposer. Honest action is profitable.   5. **Precedent seeding**: Finalized outcomes auto-record to EMETPrecedent      with `OutcomeSource.Optimistic`, giving future jurors real-world data      to anchor their reasoning \u2014 not just stake amounts. ## Key Properties - **Permissionless**: Anyone can propose or dispute. No owner required. - **Economically rational**: Bond > reward ensures only credible actors propose. - **Composable**: Any agent or contract can call `getOutcome(claimId)` to   read a finalized outcome. This is the oracle interface for downstream systems. - **Precedent-backed**: The Graph subgraph can index `OutcomeFinalized` events   and feed a verifiable history to AI agents evaluating trust.","version":1}},"settings":{"compilationTarget":{"src/EMETOptimisticOracle.sol":"EMETOptimisticOracle"},"evmVersion":"cancun","libraries":{},"metadata":{"bytecodeHash":"ipfs"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":200},"remappings":[":forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/"]},"sources":{"src/EMETOptimisticOracle.sol":{"keccak256":"0xe045ca1ae1de7002f72fcf5d3767935d77764b791a58c383f2ce502588552cc7","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://5803eb873f9b45f9bd56798f360480b34252ba58804c6450db572f60f5a3c3b5","dweb:/ipfs/QmTdEGRxPuPTkQ14enLhUmcX6XbUn2D7ADGchJHKj43Bt7"]},"src/EMETPrecedent.sol":{"keccak256":"0x22e3aba806621415b22e0ebe30ff239a0dcf408032044af2d2076a229d4b1aca","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://0c676518953d0f252426d6f1d6258636133834854a1b505503d8a15c049f2a28","dweb:/ipfs/QmRV7kEGVTNRh3YHfzhWFaU86qJiBDLjskzH7xeRnZgNbm"]},"src/EMETRegistry.sol":{"keccak256":"0x93eb19050088478593f6703bb6887e408d33d010cf3ba4e4b86c7e11a4c8cf9d","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://a5b754b7b09c5e2c18980cb3e0a56224cfd037492ae9f889e9cc23cc2ca5d51c","dweb:/ipfs/QmZKddVpf8WCBhaqmTeZMaE1mozwGBuew5EXhG4sMoMy1P"]},"src/EMETReputation.sol":{"keccak256":"0x84915e3fced714e09e463d858721040e904db19ad20400c2bbd6f9ce6a3091b4","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://1324bcf0ccf4369d32f1063dc2644bbe3ee467d0cd077e82d58f47b2e6afea91","dweb:/ipfs/QmcpwboUSs4AZxmSLZ6Q3afSjwCjJQkH8CXuhVckjJehnc"]},"src/interfaces/IEMET.sol":{"keccak256":"0x56847b6dc460244c009944ff87d21beeaef3bbe57fa5ccb41b07a8125db958cc","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://ccb9bbb05c3eb02ba04226686070515e7f080fe71fa7beaa163ad6198d8db876","dweb:/ipfs/Qmeibzuyx8yWLvDvGN7nMgjhBnnmQh769wThVS6mGB3fnQ"]}},"version":1}

emergencyWithdraw(address,uint256).details: Should not be needed in normal operation

finalizeOptimistic(uint256).details: Anyone can call this. If no dispute was raised, the proposed outcome      is finalized optimistically. Proposer gets bond back + small reward.

getOutcome(uint256).details: Returns `OutcomeValue.None` if not yet finalized.      This is the primary oracle interface for downstream AI agents and contracts.      Call this to know: "did EMET's community determine this claim was true?"

returns.source: How it was finalized (Optimistic or JuryVerified)

proposeOutcome(uint256,uint8,string,uint.details: Anyone can propose. Bond is held until finalization or rejection.      Only one pending proposal per claim at a time.      Challenge window begins immediately.

params.claimId: The claim to assert an outcome for
params.evidence: Off-chain URI or reasoning supporting the assertion

returns.proposalId: The ID of the new proposal

resolveDispute(uint256).details: Anyone can call this after juryDeadline. Jury majority determines outcome.      Winner (proposer or disputer) gets the loser's bond minus protocol fee.      Outcome is finalized and seeded to EMETPrecedent with juror reasonings.

params.jurors: Array of juror addresses (must be JURY_SIZE)
